public_holidays: 2027-02-20 (Saturday): anniversary of the Battle of Salta, a provincial feriado throughout the province (Ley 5032, article 1(b)).
2027-06-17 (Thursday): homage to General Martín Miguel de Güemes, commander in the wars of independence and Governor of Salta, a provincial feriado throughout the province (Ley 5032, article 1(b)).

2027-09-15 (Wednesday): culmination of the religious observances in honour of the Señor and the Virgen del Milagro, patrons of Salta since 1692, a provincial feriado throughout the province (Ley 5032, article 1(b)).
culture-cycles.note: The official Boletín Oficial instrument page publishes Ley 5032 as the texto ordenado by Ley 7.913, digesto jurídico updated to 31 July 2015 (the law itself was sanctioned on 8 September 1976 and published on 16 September 1976). Article 1 unifies and amends earlier Laws 680 and 1.067. Article 1(a) declares 13 and 14 September días no laborales throughout the province for the festivities of the Señor and the Virgen del Milagro; those two days are not feriados under this article and are not recorded here as public holidays. The same bulletin page also points to Ley 5036, likewise a texto ordenado by Ley 7.913, on 13 and 14 September as non-working days. Later amendments after 31 July 2015 were not checked. This record does not restate national weekend-observance rules for years when 20 February falls on a weekend. One-off extraordinary holidays listed in the official thematic index (for example Ley 7811 of 20 January 2014) are not recurring and are not recorded here.
